# Introduction to GRAND GROUP CORPORATION

GRAND GROUP CORPORATION stands as a distinguished and dynamic enterprise in the global chemical industry, strategically headquartered at 13F, Pacific Plaza, No. 555 Jingjia Road, Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, China. Situated in one of China's most prominent commercial and industrial hubs, the company benefits from Ningbo's robust logistics infrastructure, world-class port facilities, and proximity to major chemical manufacturing zones, positioning it at the forefront of both domestic and international chemical trade.

Since its establishment, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION has dedicated itself to the research, development, production, and distribution of a comprehensive range of chemical products. The company's diverse portfolio spans industrial chemicals, specialty chemicals, fine chemicals, pharmaceutical intermediates, and various raw materials that serve a broad spectrum of industries including pharmaceuticals, agriculture, textiles, plastics, coatings, electronics, and personal care. With a strong commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction, GRAND GROUP has built a reputation as a reliable supplier and partner for clients across Asia, Europe, North America, and beyond.

Backed by a team of experienced professionals, advanced production technologies, and strict quality control systems, the corporation continuously invests in research and development to meet evolving market demands. Guided by principles of sustainability, integrity, and excellence, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION strives to deliver value-added chemical solutions while contributing to the advancement of the global chemical industry and fostering long-term partnerships with stakeholders worldwide.
